nodes.label: Nihiltheism
nodes.description: A proposed bridge position in which the universal experience of meaninglessness does not cancel transcendence but becomes the condition under which transcendence is reinterpreted.
nodes.significance: Master concept integrating nihilistic phenomenology, apophatic reserve, and a critique of both reductive naturalism and easy religiosity.
nodes.stakes: If coherent, it offers a dissertation-level alternative to theism/atheism binaries.

nodes.label: Religious Experience of Nihilism
nodes.description: The lived encounter with radical meaninglessness as spiritually charged rather than merely intellectually concluded.
nodes.significance: Reframes nihilism as an existential event rather than a thesis alone.
nodes.stakes: Anchors the dissertation in experience instead of abstract polemic.

nodes.label: Absurd Perspective
nodes.description: The standpoint from which action appears groundless because values lack final warrant and every finite project is exposed as contingent.
nodes.significance: Connects REN to paralysis, triviality, and the levelling of practical significance.
nodes.stakes: Essential for distinguishing REN from heroic existentialism.

nodes.label: Divided Self
nodes.description: The human subject as split between worldly absorption and a pull toward what exceeds finite explanation.
nodes.significance: Provides anthropological structure for why nihilism can be universal yet differently articulated.
nodes.stakes: Connects Plato, Christianity, Kierkegaard, and phenomenological accounts of falling.

nodes.label: Infinite Nothingness
nodes.description: The experience of the finite as null before the infinite, where annihilation and disclosure coincide.
nodes.significance: Central paradox of REN: void as devastation and opening.
nodes.stakes: Supports dialogue with Pascal, Cioran, apophatic theology, and mystical language.

nodes.label: Madness, Suicide, and the Other
nodes.description: The zone where nihilism appears to terminate reason, threaten self-destruction, or gesture toward a reality irreducible to ordinary worldhood.
nodes.significance: Brings REN into contact with its darkest implications instead of sanitizing them.
nodes.stakes: Necessary for robustness because the dissertation must answer what follows when the world is experienced as nothing.

nodes.label: Christian Nihilism
nodes.description: A paradoxical configuration in which God is everything and the world is nothing, reversing secular immanence without restoring ordinary meaning.
nodes.significance: Shows REN is not merely secularized despair.
nodes.stakes: Opens comparative theology without collapsing into confessional apologetics.

recursiveQuestions: If nihilism is universal, what exactly is universal: a proposition, a mood, a phenomenological event, or a structural condition of finite consciousness?
Does REN describe transcendence, infer transcendence, or merely preserve a space that naturalism cannot close?
What differentiates transformative nihilistic conversion from psychological breakdown or aesthetic self-dramatization?

argumentTrails.title: Universal nihilism → divided self → transcendental yearning
argumentTrails.desc: Use this when defending the move from meaninglessness to a non-dogmatic account of transcendence.

argumentTrails.title: Naturalism critique → illusion of reality → apophatic reserve
argumentTrails.desc: Use this to show that rejecting flat naturalism need not entail positive metaphysical possession.

tensions.title: Universal claim vs anti-foundationalism
tensions.desc: REN says nihilism is universally experienced while also insisting that final systems break down.

tensions.title: Transcendence vs vagueness
tensions.desc: The more REN protects transcendence from reduction, the more it risks becoming indeterminate.

examinerQuestions.title: How is Nihiltheism different from negative theology?
examinerQuestions.desc: Answer by stressing the primacy of nihilistic phenomenology rather than inherited doctrine alone.
